description:
The running game: map, game mode, players, pause and time scale; move players or actors around.
Workflow: get_game_state / list_players to see what is running -> teleport (optionally snap_to_ground) ->
set_pause / set_time_dilation to freeze or slow the action while inspecting (tools keep working while paused).
Every change is undoable with history.undo.
name: game

tools.description:
Returns a summary of the running game: map, game mode, game state, time, pause, time dilation and player count.
Returns: {map, time_seconds, real_time_seconds, paused, time_dilation, game_mode, default_pawn, game_state, player_states, players}.
tools.name: game.get_game_state

returnValue.description: {map, time_seconds, real_time_seconds, paused, time_dilation, game_mode, default_pawn, game_state, player_states, players}.

default_pawn.description: Pawn class the game mode spawns for players.

game_mode.description: Game mode class (empty on clients or worlds without one).

map.description: Loaded map name (without the streaming prefix).

player_states.description: Player states known to the game state.

real_time_seconds.description: Real time since the world started, in seconds.

time_seconds.description: Game time in seconds (affected by pause and time dilation).

returnValue.title: GameToolGameState

tools.description:
Lists player controllers with their pawns, locations and view rotations.
Returns: One entry per player controller, in the world's controller order (the first is the local player in single-player games).
tools.name: game.list_players

returnValue.description: One entry per player controller, in the world's controller order (the first is the local player in single-player games).

ref.description: Pass this back to tools that take this object

local.description: Whether the controller is local (has a viewport and input).

name.description: Player name from the player state (empty without one).

pawn.description: The possessed pawn (null when the player has none). (Pawn (null if none))

ref.description: Pass this back to tools that take this object

tools.description:
Pauses or unpauses the game. Tools keep working while paused. Undoable.
Returns: The requested state and whether the world reports itself paused. Fails if the world has no player controller (pausing goes through one).

paused.description: true to pause, false to resume.

tools.name: game.set_pause

returnValue.description: The requested state and whether the world reports itself paused. Fails if the world has no player controller (pausing goes through one).

world_paused.description: Whether the world reports itself paused now.

returnValue.title: GameToolPauseResult

tools.description:
Slows down or speeds up game time. Undoable.
Returns: The time dilation now in effect (engine-clamped) and the previous one. Fails if the value is out of range.

value.description: Time scale between 0.0001 and 20, e.g. 0.25 for slow motion (1 = normal).

tools.name: game.set_time_dilation

returnValue.description: The time dilation now in effect (engine-clamped) and the previous one. Fails if the value is out of range.

time_dilation.description: Time dilation now in effect (the engine clamps to its global min/max).

returnValue.title: GameToolTimeDilationResult

tools.description:
Moves an actor (default: the first player's pawn) to a location, optionally turning it. For pawns the controller's view rotation turns too. Undoable.
Returns: The moved actor's reference and name, its final location and whether it was snapped to the ground. Fails if no target is given and there is no player pawn.

location.description: Destination [x,y,z] in cm, e.g. [0,0,200]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

rotation.description: Optional new rotation [pitch,yaw,roll], e.g. [0,90,0]. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

snap_to_ground.description: Drop the actor so the bottom of its bounds rests on the ground below the location (Epic snap_to_ground).

target.description: Actor or pawn to move (node id, path, actor:Name, "pawn"); default the player pawn. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: game.teleport

returnValue.description: The moved actor's reference and name, its final location and whether it was snapped to the ground. Fails if no target is given and there is no player pawn.

snapped_to_ground.description: True when snap_to_ground found ground and moved the actor onto it.

teleported.description: Reference of the moved actor (node id, else actor:Name).

returnValue.title: GameToolTeleportResult
